desc:

title: File:Empty apartment room with extension cord.jpg
desc: Photograph of a small empty room in an apartment unit. The floor is hardwood and the walls are white plaster. One window with an AC unit attached lets in sunlight. A black bag is left on a part of the structure on the left. The AC unit is plugged in via an extension cord strewn across the floor.
